dramas.title: Bon Appétit, Your Majesty
dramas.description: Lita, a cheerful modern chef, suddenly finds herself in a royal palace and becomes the personal chef for Emperor Raynard.

dramas.title: Vincenzo
dramas.description: An Italian-Korean lawyer working for the mafia returns to Seoul to seek revenge, but his mission becomes even more dangerous when he gets entangled with a corrupt law firm.

dramas.title: Crash Landing on You
dramas.description: A wealthy chaebol heiress accidentally crash-lands in North Korea and unexpectedly falls in love with an army captain who risks everything to protect her.

dramas.title: Twenty-Five Twenty-One
dramas.description: In a time when dreams seem out of reach, a teen fencer pursues big ambitions and meets a hardworking young man who seeks to rebuild his life.

dramas.title: Alchemy of Souls
dramas.description: A powerful sorceress in a blind woman's body encounters a man from a prestigious family who wants her help to change his destiny.

dramas.title: All of Us Are Dead
dramas.description: A high school becomes ground zero for a zombie virus outbreak. Trapped students must fight their way out or turn into one of the infected.

dramas.title: Castaway Diva
dramas.description: Fifteen years after being stranded on a deserted island, an aspiring singer returns to society, undeterred by new challenges in pursuing her dream.

dramas.title: Doctor Slump
dramas.description: Two brilliant doctors who used to be rivals in high school reunite at the lowest point in their lives, finding comfort and romance in each other.

dramas.title: Daily Dose of Sunshine
dramas.description: A determined young nurse navigates the complex world of mental healthcare and the diverse lives of patients in a psychiatric ward.

dramas.title: Extraordinary Attorney Woo
dramas.description: Brilliant attorney Woo Young-woo tackles challenges in the courtroom and beyond as a rookie at a top law firm and a woman on the autism spectrum.

dramas.title: Guardian: The Lonely and Great God (Goblin)
dramas.description: An immortal goblin searches for his human bride to end his cursed eternal life, only to find himself falling deeply in love with her.

dramas.title: Good Boy
dramas.description: Olympic medalists become special police officers to combat violent crime and injustice using their unique athletic skills.

dramas.title: Gyeongseong Creature
dramas.description: In spring 1945 Gyeongseong during Japanese rule, an entrepreneur and a sleuth battle for survival against a monstrous creature born of human greed.

dramas.title: Hospital Playlist
dramas.description: Five doctors who have been friends since medical school share a love for music while saving lives together at Yulje Medical Center.

dramas.title: Hometown Cha-Cha-Cha
dramas.description: A big-city dentist opens a practice in a close-knit seaside village, home to a charming jack-of-all-trades who is her polar opposite.

dramas.title: It's Okay to Not Be Okay
dramas.description: An antisocial children's book author and a selfless psychiatric ward caretaker heal each other's emotional and psychological wounds.

dramas.title: Itaewon Class
dramas.description: An ex-con and his ambitious crew fight to turn their ambitious street bar into a massive food franchise while getting revenge on a corrupt conglomerate.

dramas.title: Karma
dramas.description: Six individuals intertwined in an inescapable, ill-fated web of karma struggle to break free from their dark pasts and tragic destinies.

dramas.title: Love Next Door
dramas.description: A successful architect reunites with his childhood friend when she returns to Korea to reset her life, rekindling feelings they tried to forget.

dramas.title: Lovely Runner
dramas.description: A devoted fan travels back in time to 2008 to save her favorite top star from a tragic fate, rewriting their destiny together.

dramas.title: My Demon
dramas.description: A pitiless 200-year-old demon temporarily loses his powers after getting entangled with a haughty, workaholic heiress, leading to a contract marriage.

dramas.title: Nevertheless
dramas.description: The intoxicating charm of a flirtatious art school classmate pulls a heartbroken woman into a friends-with-benefits relationship despite her misgivings.

dramas.title: Oh My Venus
dramas.description: A stressed lawyer teams up with a world-renowned personal trainer to regain her health and confidence, discovering love along the way.

dramas.title: Our Beloved Summer
dramas.description: Years after filming a viral high school documentary, two bickering ex-lovers are pulled back in front of the camera and into each other’s lives.

dramas.title: Queen of Tears
dramas.description: The queen of department stores and the prince of supermarkets weather a marital crisis, until a miraculous resurgence of love begins to bloom.

dramas.title: Reply 1988
dramas.description: A heartwarming journey back to 1988 Seoul following five childhood friends and their families living in the close-knit neighborhood of Ssangmundong.

dramas.title: Resident Playbook
dramas.description: Spin-off of Hospital Playlist following the turbulent, earnest, and hilarious everyday lives of obstetrics and gynecology residents at Jongno Yulje Hospital.

dramas.title: Squid Game
dramas.description: Hundreds of cash-strapped players accept a strange invitation to compete in children’s games for a tempting prize, with deadly high stakes.

dramas.title: Start-Up
dramas.description: Young entrepreneurs aspiring to launch virtual dreams into reality compete for success and romance in the cutthroat world of Korea’s high-tech industry.

dramas.title: Sweet Home
dramas.description: As humans turn into savage monsters and wreak terror, one troubled teen and his apartment neighbors fight to hold onto their humanity and survive.

dramas.title: The Atypical Family
dramas.description: Once blessed with unique superpowers, a family loses their abilities due to modern-day afflictions until a mysterious woman enters their lives.

dramas.title: The Glory
dramas.description: Years after surviving horrific abuse in high school, a woman puts an elaborate revenge scheme in motion to make the perpetrators pay for their crimes.

dramas.title: The Judge from Hell
dramas.description: A demon from hell possesses the body of an elite judge to punish remorseless criminals and send them straight to the underworld.

dramas.title: The Penthouse: War in Life
dramas.description: Residents of Hera Palace, a luxury 100-floor penthouse apartment, harbor dark secrets and fierce rivalries driven by greed and ambition.

dramas.title: Under the Queen's Umbrella
dramas.description: A spirited queen navigates palace rivalries and political intrigue while striving to rein in her unruly sons to turn one of them into the next Joseon king.

dramas.title: Twinkling Watermelon
dramas.description: A CODA high school student with a gift for music time travels to 1995, where he forms a band with the teenage version of his father.

dramas.title: Vagabond
dramas.description: When a mysterious plane crash kills his nephew, a stuntman embarks on a dangerous quest to uncover a massive national corruption conspiracy.

dramas.title: When Life Gives You Tangerines
dramas.description: Follows the adventurous and bittersweet lives of Ae-soon, a rebellious dreamer, and Gwan-sik, an unyielding man of action, born on Jeju Island in the 1950s.

dramas.title: What's Wrong with Secretary Kim
dramas.description: An egotistical vice chairman of a major company is thrown into turmoil when his capable secretary of nine years suddenly announces her resignation.

dramas.title: Welcome to Samdal-ri
dramas.description: After suffering a sudden fall from grace, a famous fashion photographer returns to her hometown on Jeju Island and reconnects with her childhood best friend.

actors.name: Go Youn-jung

actors.name: Gong Yoo

actors.name: Han So-hee
actors.bio: Dynamic actress celebrated for The World of the Married, Nevertheless, My Name, and Gyeongseong Creature.

actors.name: Hyun Bin
actors.bio: Legendary Hallyu leading actor renowned for Crash Landing on You, Secret Garden, and Memories of the Alhambra.

actors.name: Ji Chang-wook
actors.bio: Electrifying action and romance powerhouse star of Welcome to Samdal-ri, Healer, and The K2.

actors.name: Kim Da-mi
actors.bio: Sensational talent acclaimed for Itaewon Class, Our Beloved Summer, and The Witch.

actors.name: Kim Ji-won
actors.bio: Beloved top actress famed for Queen of Tears, Descendants of the Sun, and Fight for My Way.

actors.name: Kim Seon-ho
actors.bio: Charming leading actor of Hometown Cha-Cha-Cha, Start-Up, and The Childe.

actors.name: Kim Soo-hyun
actors.bio: One of Korea's highest-paid top actors, celebrated for Queen of Tears, It's Okay to Not Be Okay, and My Love from the Star.

actors.name: Lee Jong-suk
actors.bio: Award-winning leading man of Big Mouth, W: Two Worlds, and While You Were Sleeping.

actors.name: Lee Jun-ho
actors.bio: Baeksang Best Actor recipient and 2PM member known for King the Land and The Red Sleeve.

actors.name: Lee Min-ho
actors.bio: Global Hallyu megastar recognized for The King: Eternal Monarch, Boys Over Flowers, and Pachinko.

actors.name: Park Min-young
actors.bio: Rom-com royalty known for What's Wrong with Secretary Kim, Marry My Husband, and Healer.

actors.name: Park Seo-joon
actors.bio: Prolific international icon starring in Itaewon Class, What's Wrong with Secretary Kim, and Gyeongseong Creature.

actors.name: Park Shin-hye
actors.bio: Esteemed versatile actress famous for The Judge from Hell, Doctor Slump, Pinocchio, and The Heirs.

actors.name: Shin Min-a
actors.bio: Beloved veteran actress leading Hometown Cha-Cha-Cha, Oh My Venus, and Karma.

actors.name: Song Joong-ki
actors.bio: Top actor renowned for Vincenzo, Descendants of the Sun, and Reborn Rich.

actors.name: Song Kang
actors.bio: Global favorite nicknamed Son of Netflix, starring in Sweet Home, Nevertheless, and My Demon.

actors.name: IU (Lee Ji-eun)
actors.bio: Legendary solo artist and acclaimed actress known for Hotel Del Luna, My Mister, and When Life Gives You Tangerines.

actors.name: Wi Ha-joon
actors.bio: Charismatic action star recognized globally in Squid Game, Bad and Crazy, and Gyeongseong Creature.

reviews.review_text: Sangat menghibur dan lucu! Chemistry pemerannya luar biasa.
Visual dan kulinernya bikin laper setiap nonton!
Song Joong-ki as Vincenzo is legendary. One of the best crime comedies ever.
Masterpiece. Perfect balance of laughter, tears, and romance.
Kim Soo-hyun & Kim Ji-won chemistry broke all records for a reason.

profiles.bio: K-Drama enthusiast exploring the best stories.
